desc.zh: 从逐个子序列的宽度，推导每个排序位置的最大值与最小值贡献。
desc.en: Count how often each sorted position contributes a maximum or minimum.

complexity: O(n log n) time; O(n) space

concepts.name: Extremum contribution counting
concepts.description: Count position subsets by their unique largest and smallest sorted indices.

concepts.name: Position multiplicity
concepts.description: Equal values at different positions still define separate subsequences.
